predeclared_questions: How much of H1 loss comes from price versus fees, fill friction and funding?

Were net targets too far from entry given the quantity, stop and holding horizon?

limitations: All variants are development diagnostics on already inspected data; no new independent profitability claim.
June-July validation is not rerun for new variants; August-September remains reserved.
No changes to signal parameters or leverage cap after observing results.
Hourly OHLC cannot substantiate 50 trades per day for a sequential single-position system.
Smaller risk changes instrument eligibility and trade selection through lot rounding, not just position size.
